title: Playing hymns for his sister; Madge Barney
summary: Howard played hymns on cornet while his sister sang, and a family friend, Madge Barney, played piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about when you went around playing in churches, did you play the Chautauqua in churches too? Did you play that music anyplace?
Oh, no, I didn't play it in churches. I'd play --
And my sister was singing. I'd play hymns and play for her.
You say your sister was singing?
Did you play together at the same time, she'd be singing and you'd play the cornet?
Yeah, uh-huh. Well, who would play piano, anybody else in the family?
Is that one of the family too?
Just a friend of the family.
And I remembered her name, doggone it.
Was that Ohio, when you were playing --
Uh-huh. Can you put it up a little closer, Paul? Because you've got some --
Boy, I'm telling you, you all are digging things out of me that I didn't think would every come out of me in my life. Come on, let's put this thing down for a minute.
What do you mean, you want to stop for a minute?

I'm not doing well. I can't remember the people's names. Madge Barney. Maybe Susie might know the Barneys out of Steubenville, Ohio, but I doubt it because she didn't know anybody very much. I was too young.
